title: Cracked Cosmic Egg
description: A large, transparent egg sits centered in a dark, thorny nest. The egg is cracked with pieces falling away, revealing a glowing pink orb with a simple face and a smaller sad-faced sun-like orb with radiating pink lines inside. Pink petals and thorny vines surround the base against a black background with faint white line art and stars.
prompt: Surreal dark artwork of a large cracked transparent egg resting in a nest of thorny green vines and pink petals. Inside the egg float a glowing bright pink orb with a simple face and a smaller sad-faced sun with pink radiating lines. Black background with white line art foliage and stars, mysterious and melancholic atmosphere, detailed linework with soft glowing highlights.
